mermaid.line: But what if I'm a mermaid
stanza: But what if I'm a mermaid
In these jeans of his with her name still on it
Hey, but I don't care cause sometimes
I said sometimes I hear my voice, and it's been
Here, silent all these years

mermaid.line: Come on down to the Mermaid Café
stanza: Come on down to the Mermaid Café
And I will buy you a bottle of wine
And we'll laugh and toast to nothing
And smash our empty glasses down
Let's have a round for these freaks and these soldiers
A round for these friends of mine
Let's have another round for the bright red devil
Who keeps me in this tourist town

renegade.line: An extract from Kate’s anthology of poetry: End TimesI'm a renegade
stanza: An extract from Kate’s anthology of poetry: End TimesI'm a renegade
Out for the truth
I will shout from the rooftops
You can find me
Hanging about down in New Cross
Or sitting it out on my stoop with my shoes off
Shaking my head
Because too many are too lost.
